channel.title: Medics Musings: FDA recall roundup
channel.description: FDA drug, device and food recalls from the last 30 days, updated weekly from openFDA.

item.title: Class I drug recall: UMARY Acido Hialuronico, also known as: "New Hyaluronic Acid 850mg Sealed 30 Caps", Suplem (IBeautiStore.com)
item.description: Marketed without approved NDA/ANDA- FDA laboratory analysis found product to be tainted with undeclared ingredients: Dexamethasone, Diclofenac and Omeprazole. Recalling firm: IBeautiStore.com. Status: Ongoing.
